facts.rationale: Preserves exact thresholds and participating-slot guards while correcting the baseline's unbounded every-subsequent-invocation claim.
facts.value: For currently participating slots, slowdown counter 0 is idle, 1 through 99 increment, and 100 clears to 0 while restoring speed to 1.0F. Each counter restores global speed independently. When gm_801B9600() <= 1, the u16 completion counter increments without a local reset on other callbacks. If its incremented value exceeds 100, the callback restores speed and calls gm_8016B33C(5) followed by gm_8016B328(). There is no one-shot guard: qualifying requests repeat while the incremented counter remains above 100, but eventual u16 wrap interrupts that condition if external flow does not stop the process.
